vlm_prompt: Describe the image in one detailed and factual paragraph. Identify all clearly visible objects and describe their observable attributes, including color, size, shape, material, pattern, and state when applicable. Describe the spatial and semantic relationships between the objects, such as their relative positions, physical interactions, and actions. Include only information that is directly supported by the image. Do not guess identities, intentions, locations, causes, or other information that cannot be visually verified. If an attribute or relationship is uncertain, omit it. Do not use bullet points, headings, JSON, or explanations. Return only the final description as a single coherent paragraph.
